inputs.canonical_source: Strict JSONL session histories owned by one SessionStore; SQLite index state is never a lineage source.
inputs.lineage_envelope: A v1 session_meta.created.lineage mapping with storage_id, session_id, parent_session_id, parent_storage_id, and fork_until_turn_id.
inputs.session_id: A non-empty canonical session identifier scoped to the current SessionStore.storage_id.

resolution.rule: The returned session_id equals the requested ID, storage_id equals the current store, and resolving root_session_id again returns itself.

legacy.rule: A strict history without a lineage envelope is a legacy root with root_session_id equal to session_id; it is never rewritten or inferred from copied content.

rules: Every new session created through the session-create route writes one immutable v1 envelope in its canonical created metadata.
A root has null parent_session_id, parent_storage_id, and fork_until_turn_id. A forked child has non-empty parent_session_id and fork_until_turn_id, and parent_storage_id equals storage_id.
Resolution traverses only same-store parent links, detects self-parent and cycles, and returns the final root without scanning the full store.
A session replacement that touches a lineage-enabled history must retain exactly its original envelope; duplicate or conflicting envelopes fail closed.
The derived session search index remains schema-compatible and contains no lineage fields.
errors: Malformed IDs, envelope schema mismatch, or a record session_id/storage_id mismatch raise SessionLineageError with malformed_id or invalid_resolution.
A missing requested record raises record_not_found; a missing referenced parent raises dangling_parent; neither is treated as a legacy root.
Self-parent, cycles, duplicate/conflicting envelopes, and a different parent storage raise explicit SessionLineageError reasons and never produce a root.
An unreadable strict source raises resolver_unavailable and must not fall back to FTS/index state or an empty result.

compatibility.legacy_history: No envelope means self-root only; legacy histories are not rewritten or guessed.
compatibility.cross_store: reject; v1 has no import or profile rebinding.
compatibility.index_v1: unchanged; lineage is canonical JSONL metadata and root is derived.
